answer: In an agent marketplace trading pigment, relic replicas, and pearl jewelry, voting power in dispute resolution is proportional to tokens locked in escrow, with a month-long withdrawal delay. Splitting one stake among a thousand identities gives an attacker no extra votes: each identity receives only its share of the same total weight. To gain more influence, the attacker must acquire and immobilize more tokens, tying up capital for the full lock period.
